limitations: Only the eight candidate PNGs listed by supplemental-01.input.json were opened. No other candidate or reference image was loaded. These operational states have no independently inspected per-state pixel reference, so this is a contract-based visual review and makes no pixel-match claim.

All eight current PNG hashes match both expected_png_sha256 and the corresponding case evidence screenshot hash. All sidecars identify round 1, run a1baf3fe3dc2, and the stated frozen binary and source hashes. Existing mechanical checks were read as supplied evidence and were not rerun or substituted for visual inspection.

The native captures are 618 by 824 logical pixels. The case metadata records a two-times physical reference scale for the 1236 by 1648 PW5 profile; this review does not assert independent physical-resolution pixel equivalence.

Static frames cannot establish pointer reachability, touch target behavior, whole-control press inversion, outside dismissal, elapsed timing, download interruption, or actual file deletion. Existing sidecar operation checks provide supporting state evidence, not a new independent runtime replay.

The cancel-all and pause-all captures show page 1 containing completed jobs. Their cancelled or paused jobs are on the unshown page 2. The supplied page-two PNG captures an earlier queued state, so this batch does not visually establish the final cancelled and paused row presentations.

The queue sidecars list a cancel-all action, including an enabled action in the page-two state, while these dedicated queue frames visibly expose only Pause all or Resume all and Close. HANDOFF section 5.1 explicitly requires those visible controls; this review makes no acceptance claim for the additional cancel-all action's visible entry point.

No empty queue, failed-job, or retry presentation is present in this batch. Real fixture titles, queue counts, progress, storage values, and capture time are allowed data differences, while geometry, clipping, pagination, and truthful state remain applicable.

This batch contains no closed-reader frame, missing-hardware variant, quality-unavailable state, or authorization state. It cannot qualify pure-artwork reader behavior, physical e-ink refresh, hardware sleep/wake, memory use at 512 MiB, or other physical hardware behavior.
Zero new suggestions in this eight-case supplemental batch does not establish a complete clean round, complete matrix coverage, or the required consecutive-clean-round streak.
